meta.name: Obliterated
meta.description: A special forces team thwarts a deadly plot in Sin City and parties accordingly. But when the real threat emerges, they must sober up to save Las Vegas.

videos.title: Real American Heroes
videos.overview: After thwarting an arms dealer's deadly plans, a special forces team celebrates the end of their mission with a rager until sobering news ends the party.

videos.title: Born in the U.S.S.R.
videos.overview: The team races to Area 52 to grill Koslov and his buyer, and Maya heads to the strip club with a new friend who threatens to sabotage their mission.

videos.title: Craps
videos.overview: On deadline, the group's search for Litvin leads them to an even bigger discovery. In the air, Paul has bizarre visions while maneuvering the Vulture.

videos.title: Walks of Shame
videos.overview: With the Vulture grounded, the team splits: McKnight and Ava find an ally, Gomez helps Maya overcome her fear, and Trunk and Lana plot an exit strategy.

videos.title: Shots! Shots! Shots!
videos.overview: The agents infiltrate the lake house to seize the nuke. But as tensions rise within the Russian ranks, the team finds themselves caught in the crossfire.

videos.title: From Vegas with Love
videos.overview: The clock is ticking as the women search for clues in a nightclub and the men deal with Elvis impersonators. Elsewhere, Hagerty may have met his match.

videos.title: Make It Rain
videos.overview: As the FBI takes over for Ava and the team, a close Koslov associate steps up. On the Strip, plans for an exchange unravel when pandemonium breaks out.

videos.title: Last Call
videos.overview: The mission kicks into high gear when the squad learns shocking news about the nuke. It's all hands on deck to stop the explosion before it's too late.
